GREAT FOODS - AMAZING SERVICES
Nov 2024 • Friends
During my trip to Phu Quoc, I had the pleasure of dining at Soi 14, a fantastic Thai restaurant that truly impressed me with its flavors and service. From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with warm smiles and a vibrant, cozy atmosphere that made us feel instantly welcome.

The food was absolutely incredible! Each dish was a delightful explosion of authentic Thai flavors, perfectly balanced between sweet, sour, spicy, and savory. We tried several dishes, but the standout was the Pad Thai – fresh, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. The green curry was another favorite, rich and creamy with just the right level of spice. The use of fresh ingredients and attention to detail in every dish was evident.

The service was impeccable. The staff were friendly, attentive, and very knowledgeable about the menu. They were more than happy to recommend dishes and even adjusted the spice levels to suit our preferences. Their genuine hospitality added so much to the overall experience.

If you’re looking for amazing Thai food in Phu Quoc. Soi 14 is the place to go. Exceptional dishes, wonderful service, and a lovely ambiance make it a must-visit spot on the island. Highly recommended!
